research_question: Does a causal M1 Bollinger-inside-Keltner compression state followed by a completed-bar release, traded in the direction of standard detrended linear-regression momentum, create enough immediate XAUUSD continuation to survive frozen P75 execution over 30 seconds?
source_basis: MetaQuotes Bollinger bands squeeze code base: squeeze occurs while Bollinger Bands are inside Keltner Channel; no-entry during compression and breakout state after release.
Open-source TradingView Keltner/Bollinger Squeeze: squeeze = Bollinger Bands encapsulated by Keltner Channel.
Current MT5 Squeeze Momentum implementations use Bollinger/Keltner state plus a detrended linear-regression momentum histogram whose sign gives direction.
Open-source XAUUSD Bollinger Scalper explicitly applies Bollinger/Keltner squeeze logic to gold.

frozen_signal.squeeze_on: BB upper < KC upper AND BB lower > KC lower
frozen_signal.release: previous completed M1 bar squeeze_on AND current completed M1 bar not squeeze_on
frozen_signal.momentum: 20-bar linear-regression endpoint of close minus average(midpoint of 20-bar highest-high/lowest-low, SMA20 close)
frozen_signal.entry: first executable P75 tick at/after release bar right edge

failure_rule: If the single classic M1 squeeze-release profile fails supply/day or direct-net gate, retire SQRM rather than tune it on Stage-A.
advance_rule: If it passes, freeze unchanged for independent later-January validation.
